svg.aria-label: Sketch: an aerial view of the Alamodome in San Antonio under a clear sky. The domed stadium fills the middle of the frame as a long box seen from a corner, its flat roof slung from three tall tapering pylons with cables fanning down to the roof edges, a fourth pylon hidden behind the centre one. A rounded glass entrance pavilion stands at the near corner above a plaza. The Tower of the Americas rises behind the roof at left of centre with its observation deck and spire, and the downtown skyline runs across the back. A highway and trees at left, a parking lot at lower right. No people. Drawn after an NBC News photograph.
